mapper.select: SELECT IDENTITY_ID, USER_ID, REAL_NAME, RRN_ENCRYPTED, RRN_HASH, VERIFIED_AT, PORTONE_IMP_UID, CREATED_AT FROM USER_IDENTITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT IDENTITY_ID, USER_ID, REAL_NAME, RRN_ENCRYPTED, RRN_HASH, VERIFIED_AT, PORTONE_IMP_UID, CREATED_AT FROM USER_IDENTITY WHERE RRN_HASH = #{rrnHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_IDENTITY (USER_ID, REAL_NAME, RRN_ENCRYPTED, RRN_HASH, VERIFIED_AT, PORTONE_IMP_UID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{rrnEncrypted}, #{rrnHash}, #{verifiedAt}, #{portoneImpUid})
